title: CR-Bench-v2: Evaluating the Real-World Utility of AI Code Review Agents
title_zh: CR-Bench-v2：评估AI代码评审智能体的真实世界效用

paragraphs.en: CR-Bench-v2以缺陷为中心评估代码评审智能体，最强系统仅检出约33%已知缺陷。 The rapid growth of automated code generation has created a pressing need for automated code review. Yet code review resists full automation: it depends on context beyond the \textit{diff}, on the author's intent, and on judgments about design and maintainability on which even expert reviewers disagree. Existing code review benchmarks lack standardization and rely largely on noisy human review comments scored with text-similarity metrics, which reward surface overlap and fail to measure precision. We introduce \texttt{CR-Bench}, a defect-centric evaluation framework that recasts SWE-Bench issues as pull-request review tasks with full repository context. After filtering for review-detectable defects and grounding each to a single originating pull request, \texttt{CR-Bench} contains 584 instances, with a 174-instance \texttt{CR-Bench-Verified} subset derived from SWE-Bench Verified. Each instance pairs a pull request with a known defect, its ground-truth fix, and a taxonomy label for bug category, impact, and severity. We propose two complementary metrics: \emph{Known-Defect Detection Rate} (KDDR), which measures whether an agent identifies the labeled defect, and \emph{Usefulness Rate}, which measures the fraction of review comments that are actionable. We evaluate eight code review agents over four backbones, plus commercially available Gemini Code Assist, using three independent LLM judges. Even the strongest systems detect only about one-third of known defects (KDDR $\approx$ 33\%), and Gemini Code Assist detects 8.1\%.
paragraphs.zh: CR-Bench-v2以缺陷为中心评估代码评审智能体，最强系统仅检出约33%已知缺陷。自动化代码生成的快速增长使得对自动化代码评审的需求日益迫切。 然而代码评审难以完全自动化：它依赖于 \textit{diff} 之外的上下文、作者意图，以及关于设计与可维护性的判断——即便是专家评审者对此也存在分歧。 现有的代码评审基准缺乏标准化，且主要依赖含噪声的人工评审意见，并用文本相似度指标进行评分，这些指标只奖励表面重合，无法衡量精确率。 我们提出 \texttt{CR-Bench}，一个以缺陷为中心的评估框架，它将 SWE-Bench 的问题重构为具有完整仓库上下文的拉取请求评审任务。 经过筛选仅保留可由评审发现的缺陷，并将每个缺陷对应到单一的原始拉取请求后，\texttt{CR-Bench} 包含 584 个实例，其中包含一个源自 SWE-Bench Verified 的 174 个实例的 \texttt{CR-Bench-Verified} 子集。 每个实例将一个带有已知缺陷的拉取请求与其真值修复方案，以及用于缺陷类别、影响和严重程度的分类标签配对。 我们提出两个互补的指标：\emph{已知缺陷检出率}（KDDR），衡量智能体是否识别出被标注的缺陷；以及\emph{有用率}，衡量评审意见中可操作意见的比例。 我们在四个骨干模型上评估了八个代码评审智能体，外加商用的 Gemini Code Assist，并使用三个独立的 LLM 评审裁判。 即使是最强的系统也仅能检出约三分之一的已知缺陷（KDDR $\approx$ 33\%），而 Gemini Code Assist 的检出率为 8.1\%。
